activities.title: Hardware, software or peopleware?
activities.intro: Sort the 9 items on the slide. Put each one in the right group: hardware, software or peopleware.

blocks.prompt: Sort each item into the right group.
items: The taxpayer filling out a form online

help: Can you touch it? Then it is hardware.
Instructions you can't touch, like a program or Windows, are software.
Any person who uses or supports the system is peopleware, including the taxpayer.
